SELECT SEQ_CHALLENGE_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHALLENGE ( CHALLENGE_NO, MEMBER_NO, CHALLENGE_TITLE, CHALLENGE_DESC, CHALLENGE_TYPE, GOAL_COUNT, START_DATE, END_DATE ) VALUES ( #{challengeNo}, #{memberNo}, #{challengeTitle}, #{challengeDesc}, #{challengeType}, #{goalCount}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
mapper.select: SELECT C.CHALLENGE_NO, C.CHALLENGE_TITLE, C.CHALLENGE_DESC, C.CHALLENGE_TYPE, C.GOAL_COUNT, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, C.CHALLENGE_STATUS, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHALLENGE_MEMBER WHERE CHALLENGE_NO = C.CHALLENGE_NO) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT, (SELECT CERT_COUNT FROM CHALLENGE_MEMBER WHERE CHALLENGE_NO = C.CHALLENGE_NO AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AS MY_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHALLENGE_MEMBER WHERE CHALLENGE_NO = C.CHALLENGE_NO AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AS IS_JOINED, NVL((SELECT IS_COMPLETE FROM CHALLENGE_MEMBER WHERE CHALLENGE_NO = C.CHALLENGE_NO AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}), 'N') AS IS_COMPLETE FROM CHALLENGE C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.CHALLENGE_NO = #{challengeNo}
SELECT CHALLENGE_NO FROM CHALLENGE WHERE CHALLENGE_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND END_DATE < SYSDATE

SELECT C.CHALLENGE_NO, C.CHALLENGE_TITLE, C.CHALLENGE_TYPE, C.GOAL_COUNT, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, C.CHALLENGE_STATUS, CM.CERT_COUNT AS MY_COUNT, CM.IS_COMPLETE FROM CHALLENGE_MEMBER CM JOIN CHALLENGE C ON C.CHALLENGE_NO = CM.CHALLENGE_NO WHERE CM.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY CM.JOIN_DATE DESC
